newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps ups Eastman Kodak debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps ups Eastman Kodak debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Tuesday it raised its ratings on Eastman Kodak Co's senior debt to Double-A-Minus from Single-A-Plus and its commercial paper to D-One-Plus from D-One.
About $560 million of debt is affected by the changes.
Duff & Phelps cited strong credit protection measures and improved operating performance for the upgrade.

Duff & Phelps said Eastman Kodak has also benefitted from the repositioning of the copier business in 1996 through the sale of its copier sales and marketing organization. The firm also cited cost control measures.
Duff & Phelps said, however, the ratings recognize the challenges the company faces as it moves to electronic imaging technologies from silver-halide.
"Eastman Kodak's digital imaging business is unprofitable at present, and electronic technologies continue to encroach on many of the company's other silver halide businesses," Duff & Phelps said.
"Nevertheless, the company's core photographic business remains a strong franchise and a consistent generator of cash flow, despite intense competitive pressures in key markets," it said.
Eastman Kodak shares traded off 5/8 at 79-3/8.
